coPrivacy.title: Co & your privacy
coPrivacy.p1: Co uses AI. What you write to Co is sent to the AI service for an answer. Co is not a therapist or mediator and does not replace professional help.
coPrivacy.p2: Conversations with Co are not automatically shared with the other parent or a professional. Co doesn't send messages, change appointments, or share overviews without your confirmation.
coPrivacy.p3: In the conversation window, your chat remains available only during that session. In 'Share your thoughts', you can choose to save it on this device or delete it.
coPrivacy.p4: Processing and retention policies with the AI service are still under review. For now, use fictional data only, not sensitive family information. No usage statistics are shared with professionals.
